fusions.name: Butting Blaze
fusions.desc: A butting strike that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Will Not Be Quenched
fusions.desc: Hurls a flame that deals 30 damage, ignoring the target's resistances, and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Planted on the Crag
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 15%. A ring of flame fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1 second.

fusions.name: Shrugged Off
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a shield worth 12% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
